candidates.concept: Spanish language, translation and language in society
candidates.assessment: A complete24-course trial includes psycholinguistics with experimental language study, stylistic grammar/discourse, literary interpretation, rhetoric, cultural media and qualitative research. These are substantial linguistic/cultural tools but do not implement Spanish sociolinguistics, translation with intercultural equivalence, or inquiry into regional language varieties and source cultures. The shortfall is not merely absent language acquisition.

candidates.concept: Spanish-language literature, media and cultural diversity
candidates.assessment: A complete24-course trial tests all six literature courses, film/text, documentary, media/race, imperial and Indigenous history and art/heritage. Colonial narratives, migrant memoir, interpretive minority perspectives and global museum criticism are real contributions. Their combined teaching does not sustain Spanish/Spanish-American literary traditions, regional cultural production and identity/otherness in those societies; it produces general cultural humanities.

candidates.concept: Spain and Latin American history, society and politics
candidates.assessment: A complete24-course trial combines modern/imperial history, conflict, institutions, human rights, political economy, social movements and empirical/qualitative research. These give real tools for power, colonial legacies and contemporary problems; Native American Histories specifically centres North American Indigenous experiences rather than a Latin American course. General case-choice flexibility cannot establish a sustained Spain/Latin America sequence comparable in subject to the target’s regional history and contemporary inquiry.

assessment: All59 exact-target rows reviewed:12direct generators,29curricular support,6illustrations,12conditional outcomes. Every generator is owned exactly once by one of3tested coherent concepts. No omnibus residual or outcome generates a programme. Public identity and adopted regional learning outcomes plus individual history/literature/sociolinguistics/translation entries corroborate the exact target; specific professional/further-study outcomes remain conditional.
